permissions.name: network
permissions.desc: Read your astrophotography session from your Star Glass bridge next to N.I.N.A.; stop or resume the sequence only after you confirm. With weather warnings on, the cloud, rain, dew and wind forecast for your site comes from Open-Meteo (coordinates rounded to about 1 km).

permissions.name: location
permissions.desc: Optional: the weather forecast for where you are, asked once, only when N.I.N.A. does not share its site and no coordinates are entered.
